__PKG__import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Semantic helpers for the {@code _v} unified data store.
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code "_"} — scalar value of a wrapper ({@link #getVal} / {@link #setVal})</li>
 *   <li>{@code "_choice"} — current CHOICE variant name ({@link #choice} / {@link #setChoice})</li>
 *   <li>{@code "_present_<name>"} — OPTIONAL field presence marker ({@link #isPresent} / {@link #setPresent})</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class V {
    public static final String VAL = "_";
    public static final String CHOICE = "_choice";
    public static final String PRESENT = "_present_";

    private V() {}

    // ── scalar semantics ─────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Get the scalar value stored under {@code "_"}. */
    public static Object getVal(Map<String, Object> m) { return m.get(VAL); }

    /** Set the scalar value under {@code "_"}. */
    public static void setVal(Map<String, Object> m, Object v) { m.put(VAL, v); }

    /** True if the value is a scalar wrapper (single {@code "_"} entry). */
    public static boolean isScalarWrapper(Object v) {
        return v instanceof Map && ((Map<?, ?>) v).size() == 1 && ((Map<?, ?>) v).containsKey(VAL);
    }

    /** Unwrap a scalar wrapper {@code {"_: x"}} → x; non-wrapper values pass through. */
    public static Object unwrapScalar(Object v) {
        return isScalarWrapper(v) ? ((Map<?, ?>) v).get(VAL) : v;
    }

    /** Wrap a bare value into a scalar wrapper {@code {"_: x"}}. */
    public static Map<String, Object> wrapScalar(Object v) {
        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        m.put(VAL, v);
        return m;
    }

    // ── CHOICE semantics ─────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Current CHOICE variant name, or null if unset. */
    public static String choice(Map<String, Object> m) {
        Object c = m.get(CHOICE);
        return c instanceof String ? (String) c : null;
    }

    /** Select a CHOICE variant by name. */
    public static void setChoice(Map<String, Object> m, String name) { m.put(CHOICE, name); }

    // ── OPTIONAL presence semantics ──────────────────────────────

    public static boolean isPresent(Map<String, Object> m, String field) {
        return m.containsKey(PRESENT + field);
    }

    public static void setPresent(Map<String, Object> m, String field, boolean v) {
        if (v) m.put(PRESENT + field, Boolean.TRUE);
        else m.remove(PRESENT + field);
    }

    // ── field semantics ──────────────────────────────────────────

    public static Object field(Map<String, Object> m, String name) { return m.get(name); }
    public static void setField(Map<String, Object> m, String name, Object v) { m.put(name, v); }
    public static Object removeField(Map<String, Object> m, String name) { return m.remove(name); }

    /** Cast to a mutable map, or null if not a map. */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static Map<String, Object> asMap(Object v) {
        return v instanceof Map ? (Map<String, Object>) v : null;
    }
}
